\section{\texttt{build\_citations}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.citations.build_citations}\index{Functions!build\_citations}

Build stable, ordered citations from retrieved chunks.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
build_citations(results: list[SearchResult], *, max_quote_chars: int = 180) -> list[Citation]
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{results}] \texttt{list[SearchResult]\allowbreak{}}, required.
  \item[\texttt{max\_\allowbreak{}quote\_\allowbreak{}chars}] \texttt{int}, default \texttt{180}, keyword-only.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{list[Citation]\allowbreak{}}
\apifield{Details}Documents are deduplicated in retrieval order and assigned sequential 1-based \texttt{citation\_\allowbreak{}id} values, so the same retrieval always produces the same citation list. Only the first (highest-ranked) chunk of each document is quoted.
